objective.statement: Learn the minor scales of B, F sharp and C sharp minor, in both forms.
successCriteria: I know B minor has two sharps, F sharp minor three and C sharp minor four.
I can write the harmonic and melodic forms of each.
I know the raised notes sometimes need an unusual spelling, such as E sharp or B sharp.

explanation.text: Three new minor keys have sharps in their key signatures. B minor has two sharps (F♯, C♯), F♯ minor has three (F♯, C♯, G♯) and C♯ minor has four (F♯, C♯, G♯, D♯). Each is the relative minor of a major key you know: D major, A major and E major.

music.textAlternative: B harmonic minor going up: B, C sharp, D, E, F sharp, G, A sharp, B.

explanation.caption: B harmonic minor: the 7th, A, is raised to A♯.

music.textAlternative: F sharp melodic minor going up: F sharp, G sharp, A, B, C sharp, D sharp, E sharp, F sharp.

explanation.caption: F♯ melodic minor going up: D♯ and E♯.

music.textAlternative: F sharp melodic minor coming down: F sharp, E, D, C sharp, B, A, G sharp, F sharp.

explanation.caption: Coming down: E and D natural, as in the key signature.

music.textAlternative: C sharp harmonic minor going up: C sharp, D sharp, E, F sharp, G sharp, A, B sharp, C sharp.

explanation.caption: C♯ harmonic minor: the 7th, B, is raised to B♯.

explanation.text: Notice E sharp and B sharp. In F sharp minor the raised 7th is E, so E becomes E sharp, which sounds the same as F but must be written as E sharp so that every letter name is used once. In C sharp minor the raised 7th is B sharp. Keep the letter names in order: the raised 7th of F♯ minor is E♯ and of C♯ minor is B♯, never F or C.

music.textAlternative: C sharp harmonic minor scale: C sharp, D sharp, E, F sharp, G sharp, A, B sharp, C sharp.

steps: Start on C sharp. The key signature has F sharp, C sharp, G sharp and D sharp.
Write each letter in order: C♯, D♯, E, F♯, G♯, A, B.
Raise the 7th, B, by a semitone: it is B sharp. Then finish on C sharp.
demonstration.textAlternative: C sharp harmonic minor: with B sharp as the raised 7th.
